name: fintech-console-executive-video
description: Reproducible Remotion pipeline for the executive build-vs-buy video (isolated from the application dependency graph).

scripts.video:draft: remotion render src/index.ts ExecutiveReadout output/draft.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 28 --concurrency 4
scripts.video:render: remotion render src/index.ts ExecutiveReadout output/fintech-internal-tools-vp-engineering.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 17 --color-space bt709 --concurrency 4
scripts.video:build: npm run capture && npm run narration && npm run captions && npm run video:render && npm run video:validate
